entry.title: Hefesto 1.0.3
entry.content:
• More robust installer: Agora tools install again on phones where they failed with "code 100" (PHP, .NET, Godot, Chromium…). The missing piece (dbus) now ships inside Hefesto's Linux, and if a package is left half-configured the installer reconfigures and retries on its own.
  • Support and offline import: When reporting a problem you can leave your email to get a reply. If your network won't let you download the big tools (Gradle, Node, Kotlin…), you can import the official file downloaded on another computer: the card installs it and the store recognizes it.
  • Installs on top: nothing is lost.

entry.title: Hefesto 1.0.2
entry.content:
• WebView compatible: On phones where the terminal showed a blank screen due to an old system WebView, it now works on Android 8 and later.
  • Visible errors: If anything fails, the screen itself says why and what to do — never another silent blank screen.
  • Installs on top: nothing is lost.

entry.title: Hefesto 1.0.1
entry.content:
• Server always visible: custom OpenAI-compatible providers (Zhipu GLM, OpenRouter, your own server…) now always show the “Server” field next to your key. It used to be hidden behind developer mode.
  • Installs on top of 1.0: nothing is lost.
